Name: StardewUtils SMAPI
Author: trifected
Description:
[size=4][b]StardewUtils — The All-in-One Cheat Mod[/b][/size]

Six of the most wanted quality-of-life cheats packed into a single lightweight mod. No menus to navigate, no config files to edit. Just press a key and it works.

[b]Hotkeys[/b]

[list]
[*][b]F5[/b] — Freeze / unfreeze time. The clock stops completely wherever you are. Press again to resume. A HUD message shows the exact time you froze at.[/*]
[*][b]F6[/b] — Infinite stamina. Your energy stays full no matter what you do. Farm all day without passing out.[/*]
[*][b]F7[/b] — Infinite health. You can't die in the mines or skull cavern.[/*]
[*][b]F8[/b] — Add 999,999 gold. Press it as many times as you want.[/*]
[*][b]F9[/b] — Instant crop growth. Every crop on your farm jumps to harvest-ready immediately.[/*]
[*][b]F10[/b] — Max friendship. Sets every villager you've met to 10 hearts.[/*]
[/list]
Every toggle shows a confirmation message in the game's HUD so you always know what's on.

[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[/list]
[b]Install[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already[/*]
[*]Download this mod[/*]
[*]Extract the folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]

[list]
[*]All features are toggleable — nothing is permanent until you save[/*]
[*]Time freeze works everywhere including mines, events, and festivals[/*]
[*]Crop growth only affects your main farm, not the greenhouse or Ginger Island[/*]
[*]Friendship caps at 10 hearts (2500 points) for regular villagers[/*]
[*]Press hotkeys only after your save has loaded, not on the title screen[/*]
[*]Works in both singleplayer and split-screen (affects the host player)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]

Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+. Compatible with most other mods. Does not modify any game files or assets.

[b]Uninstall[/b]

Delete the StardewUtils folder from your Mods directory. No leftover files, no save corruption.
